title: East Belfast Network Centre was reported operational after Templemore Avenue fit-out
summary: The Executive Office Social Investment Fund page recorded that support for furniture, IT, fixtures, fittings, and play equipment helped fit out the former Templemore Avenue School redevelopment as the East Belfast Network Centre, with the new facilities operational from March 2017.
source_date_field: Progress to date field states the new facilities were operational from March 2017.

title: Ardoyne youth hub works-start milestone was marked
summary: The Executive Office recorded on 2026-03-30 that ministers cut the first sod for a new purpose-built youth hub at the former Ardoyne shops on Crumlin Road, documenting the project entering a works-start phase.
source_name: First Minister and deputy First Minister cut sod at new purpose-built youth hub
source_date_field: Date published 30 March 2026 and page text recording first-sod and work-underway milestone.

limitations: This records a sod-cut and works-start milestone only; it does not evidence completion, opening, occupation, or later delivery. A related Ardoyne Youth Enterprise tender-status record exists in the manual corpus, but it uses a different source, date, and project stage.
